healthBenefits.title: Rich in Fiber
healthBenefits.text: Green beans provide dietary fiber that supports digestion and helps maintain healthy blood sugar levels.

healthBenefits.title: Vitamin C Boost
healthBenefits.text: Lemon juice and green beans together deliver a strong dose of vitamin C, supporting immune function and skin health.

healthBenefits.title: Antioxidant-Rich Herbs
healthBenefits.text: Mint and parsley contain antioxidants and essential oils that aid digestion and reduce inflammation.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil provides monounsaturated fats that support cardiovascular health and reduce bad cholesterol.

healthBenefits.title: Prebiotic Support
healthBenefits.text: Onions contain prebiotic fibers that promote healthy gut bacteria and improve digestive balance.

healthBenefits.title: Low-Calorie Nutrient Density
healthBenefits.text: This dish is naturally low in calories while being rich in vitamins, minerals, and fiber, making it ideal for balanced diets.

_ingredientsText:
• 1 Kg of green beans
• 1 onion, chopped
• 1 tablespoon parsley, chopped
• 1 1⁄2 tablespoons bread crumbs
• 1 tablespoon chopped mint or thyme
• juice of 1 lemon
• 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
• salt
• pepper (optional)
